questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: It was pretty easy - people were very nice.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: I mostly socialized with other exchange students. I would recommend to do this as early in the semester as possible.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: The language was sometimes a barrier in terms of socializing.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The friendly people.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
- Most of the students are from the US (at least the ones I had classes with) they were extremely nice 
-Time passes by fast! enjoy it.
-You will most likely be more in classes than in DK - I did have some pretty long days however almost no reading at home.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Be prepared to be more at campus than in DK.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Improving my english, getting more confident in socializing in another language, and get to travel with other exchange students at the end of my exchange. Feeling more connected to the rest of the world.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Sometimes having to much time and having to take more initiative

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
